text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before training, as I headed to the 
Trainer's Room—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nyah!? You were there, Trainer!? Say 
something next time!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Ahem. I received a letter from a fan. 
Look, look, see! Pretty neat, huh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The letter Ines Fujin showed me was 
addressed: "To Big Sis Ines."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No, just a fan. Though she told me she 
looks up to me like a big sister!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This makes me so happy! It feels like I'm 
her family, cheering her up and giving her 
strength...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"She's kind, she's cool... I really wish I 
had a big sister like her."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu. If only I had an older sister 
like that, huh...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I've always thought that I just wanted to 
run because I love running, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, I've been thinking... I want to 
run in a way that makes the people 
watching feel like we're 'family.'"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm, am I being too greedy?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks. To make sure I keep my word, 
maybe I'll push myself a bit harder than 
usual in training today!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer! Let's do our best today, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to the fan letters, Ines 
Fujin was full of energy all day long!
